mentions.name: Geomapping (geomapping.qcw.ai)
mentions.description: A script-tag embeddable tool for articles and blogs that automatically turns every mentioned location into a clickable/hoverable element spawning an interactive pop-up map, with zero manual work for the author. Place names are disambiguated using Wikipedia and coordinates matched from Google Places, with LLMs used in multiple spots; the JS is lightweight and framework-free. Aims to increase engagement and on-page time.
mentions.problem: Readers wander off to look up places mentioned in articles and never come back, hurting engagement and on-page time.
mentions.audience: Bloggers of any kind, plus the professional publishing world (exploration underway)
mentions.source_excerpt: What it does: every location in your article/blog becomes clickable/hoverable and spawns an interactive pop-up map, with zero manual work on the author.
